title: Time Dilation
meaning: For two ticks of one moving inertial clock, an observer measuring that clock in motion finds a longer interval than the proper time recorded by the clock.
variables: Δτ: proper time measured by the clock; Δt: coordinate time interval in the frame in which it moves; γ: Lorentz factor.
conditions: Constant relative velocity between inertial frames; two events are ticks at the same place in the clock's rest frame.
commonMistake: Time dilation is not merely a light-travel-time delay for receiving the clock's signals.
